description: Get the Astronomy Picture of the Day: latest, a single date, or a date range.

date.description: Optional single date (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch the APOD entry for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a single APOD entry or a list of entries for a range; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get Mars rover photos, optionally filtered by sol, camera, or earth date.

rover.description: The rover name (e.g. curiosity, opportunity, spirit).

sol.description: Optional Martian sol (day) to filter photos by.

camera.description: Optional camera abbreviation to filter photos by (e.g. FHAZ, MAST).

earth_date.description: Optional Earth date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter photos by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a photos list; on failure (rover not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the photo manifest (per-sol summary) for a Mars rover.

rover.description: The rover name (e.g. curiosity, opportunity, spirit).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a photo_manifest object; on failure (rover not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the Near Earth Object feed grouped by close-approach date.

start_date.description: Optional feed start date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the earliest available.

end_date.description: Optional feed end date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the start date.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has element_count and near_earth_objects grouped by date.

description: Get a single Near Earth Object by its id.

neo_id.description: The unique id of the near earth object.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the NEO object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the latest EPIC natural-color Earth imagery entries.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of EPIC image entries.
